title: NullWare (Update)
features:
Free and Keyless script.

WARNING - This script was only tested in Delta, meaning it works. And I don't know for others executors if it will work.

SECOND WARNING - If Flight doesn't now work, keep turning it on and off till it works, and don't equip the Sack/Bag.

Not answering to comments!

-Features
--Main--
GunAura
Noclip
Flight
FullBright
Instant Interact
Unlock Camera
Spin
--Exploits--
Spam Others Bandage (if it doesn't work, turn it off and then turn it on and try again)
Bypass Slowdowns (Works on classes)
Kill all zombies (Buggy, doesn't always work, FE)
Weld Item (Can Weld in air)
Throw Object (Buggy)
Delete Object (Doesn't work on all objects)
Orbit Object
--ESP--
ESP Items
ESP Enemies
ESP Animals (Unicorn too)
Items Chams
Enemies Chams
Animals Chams (of course, Unicorn too)
--Teleport--
Teleport to the end (Need a gun)
Teleport to tesla lab
Teleport to castle
Teleport to fort (once it stops, click it again)
Teleport to train (no players must be sitting in the Conductor seat)
--Aura--
Pick Up Aura
Ammo Aura (also collects bonds)
Armor Aura
Money Bag Aura
Crank Aura
--Auto--
Auto Play Again (also works, when you will win so you will get tped in game and not into the lobby)
Auto Bandage
Auto Snake Oil
Auto Eat (Need zombie class)
